Interesting — "nothing at 1,7" means I'm facing left toward (1,7). The notice board is at (2,7) where I stand. Let me try pressing E while facing the notice board. Actually the notice is at my own tile. Let me try facing up and pressing E, or maybe the notice board is actually at a different tile. 

Wait — the map shows 'o' only at (7,6). The notice board "at (2,7)" is where I am. But the map doesn't show 'o' at (2,7) because '@' is drawn there. So the notice board is on my tile and I'm stuck on it.

Let me try pressing E facing different directions to interact with the notice board.
